title: C3 - how much work do option names do, and how much the descriptions
doc_ref: docs.typesafe.ai/primitives/choice - the tone question uses null descriptions
note: Three ways to write the same three options. Opaque names keep the descriptions and throw the names away; null descriptions keep the names and throw the descriptions away. Whichever variant collapses is the one carrying the signal. The docs imply names alone suffice when they are self-explanatory, and this measures the size of 'suffice'. Opaque option names are mapped back through an alias so all three variants stay comparable.
